Phase A nevertheless froze the mechanism as RECOVERED after step 48 corrected toward System. The separate frozen repeated-connectivity-troubleshooting-loop independently suffices to explain why the statistics and email were never reached. A recovered chain cannot receive a plausible or strong contribution level, so the conservative linkage is co-occurrence only.
